newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 3.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Government and Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) to give priority to preparing a law to deal with crises around Japan.
-- Japan's worst oil spill from a supertanker feared to reach Kawasaki and Chiba.
-- Mandatory provision of civilian airports and ports for use by the U.S. military mulled in event of emergencies.
-- Major commercial banks to open automatic teller machine networks to brokerages.
-- About 550 billion yen to be earmarked for environmental protection and other items in fiscal 1998/99 public works programme.
-- Tanker leaks about 15,000 tonnes of crude oil, making it Japan's worst-ever oil spill.
